1.en: You can apply this trick to other problems too.
1.zh: 这个技巧也可以用来解决其他问题。

4.en: This appliance uses less power than the old one.
4.zh: 这台家电比旧的那台更省电。

5.en: The school will implement the new rule next month.
5.zh: 学校将在下个月实施这项新规定。

9.en: You can borrow my bike, provided you bring it back tonight.
9.zh: 只要你今晚还回来，就可以借我的自行车。

10.en: Small screens tend to make my eyes tired.
10.zh: 小屏幕往往会让我的眼睛疲劳。

14.en: Stretch your legs after sitting for a long time.

15.en: We still don't know the full extent of the damage.
15.zh: 我们仍不知道损坏到底有多严重。

16.en: I cannot attend the meeting, but I will watch the recording.
16.zh: 我不能参加会议，但会看录像。

20.en: The child pretended to be asleep.

22.en: That message looks fake; do not click the link.
22.zh: 那条消息看起来是假的，别点链接。

24.en: A short break can stimulate new ideas.
24.zh: 短暂休息能激发新的想法。

27.en: Online banking offers convenience when you travel.
27.zh: 旅行时，网上银行服务很方便。

28.en: Keep your ticket handy in case someone asks to see it.
28.zh: 把票放在手边，以备有人查验。

33.en: The storm caused a disaster for the small island.
33.zh: 这场风暴给这个小岛带来了灾难。

42.en: The screen size is one important dimension of the design.
42.zh: 屏幕尺寸是设计中的一个重要方面。
